# Altiora

> A free, client-side web tool that helps students aged 14 to 18 compare university course entry requirements against their own subjects and predicted grades.

Altiora is a static web application. It runs entirely in the browser, has no accounts, and stores the student's data only on the student's own device.

## Coverage

- Universities in the UK, US, Canada, Singapore and Hong Kong.
- Qualification systems: UK A-Levels, International Baccalaureate, US Advanced Placement, Singapore-Cambridge A-Levels and Hong Kong DSE.
- The dataset holds 320 course records (counted from the entries in data/courseRequirements.js).

## How requirements are sourced

- Every course requirement is checked against an official university source. Each record carries the source URL and the date it was checked.
- Where a source could not be fully verified, the record is marked partial rather than presented as confirmed. At the time of writing, 4 of the 320 records carry a partial verification status (read from data/courseRequirements.js).
- If a university does not publish a figure, Altiora does not supply one.

## Pages

- Landing page: https://usealtiora.com/
- The app: https://usealtiora.com/app.html — the tool itself. Its content is rendered by JavaScript after load; the raw HTML contains no course, requirement or field-profile content.

## Data files

- data/courseRequirements.js — course records and their verification status
- data/qualificationMappings.js — subject names per qualification system
- data/fieldProfiles.js — written profiles of the fields of study
- data/admissionTestInfo.js — admission test information
- data/university-profiles.js — university-level notes
